purpose: shared narrow arithmetic, state-scale and sparse/dense reduction capability; MAC32 L3 is the first demand and acceptance graph

operators.support: semantic and joint feature/T validation; ranges alone never grant prices

S.note: actual arithmetic-state preservation must be checked, including variable bits that optimization can prove constant

shared.method: verify existing exclusive-owner coefficients first; fit only stable failing terms

G.method: same numerical geometry function and canonical region emission; sparse carry merge is not zero delay

roles.qualification: fresh not_training local operator/reduction/state structures; cannot later become train or test
roles.train: fresh parameterized representative source families plus eligible predecessor train only
roles.validation: new widths/connections and state/geometry combinations, immutable before physical labels
roles.locked_test: new semantic sources with frozen parameters, support/refusal rules, reserve and implementation before unlock

old_train_reuse: retain original source/stage/role and physical-label identities; reextract successor features into a separate dataset snapshot
old_consumed_tests_and_final_PPA: permanently excluded from fitting and selection of successor parameters
narrow_operator_sampling: retain parent adaptive thirteen-target maximum; exact finite source/role/request admissions required per batch
G_extra_residual: zero first; attribute node/boundary/wire/ownership failures before adding correction
reset_timing: deferred per user; preserve and verify functional reset
release_gate: frozen common functions and independent quality plus actual S/G composition and complete declared search coverage; software fixtures cannot grant physical prices
physical_execution: separate exact finite admission required; this planning protocol authorizes no implicit full collection
